description: This file contains utility functions for filtering and sorting notes based on query, folder, tags, and pinned status within a note management application.

methods.name: normalize(s)
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase for case-insensitive comparisons.

methods.name: matchesQuery(note, query)
methods.description: Checks if a note matches a search query based on title, content, or tags.

methods.name: matchesFolder(note, folder)
methods.description: Determines if a note belongs to a specified folder or qualifies based on special folder labels.

methods.name: matchesTag(note, tag)
methods.description: Checks if a note contains a specific tag.

methods.name: filterAndSortNotes({ notes, query, folder, tag })
methods.description: Filters a list of notes based on query, folder, and tag, then sorts them by pinned status and update time.

ctags.name: filterAndSortNotes
ctags.pattern: /^export function filterAndSortNotes({ notes, query, folder, tag }) {$/
